card.name: Alanta dance
card.profile: Alanta is a Nigerian dance. The dance style uses a patterned movement of the hands as if fanning flames while raising one leg and facial contortions that suggest experiencing orgasm or acute pain.
sources: Source: Alanta dance on Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0. Read: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alanta_dance
